headline: KOSPI decline sparks U.S. stock gold rush; Korean retail investors accelerate shift to Wall Street
summary: Korean retail investors are withdrawing from domestic stocks at the fastest pace in over half a year. Funds are flowing into U.S. stocks despite government tax-cut measures to attract capital back.
why: Retail fund flows between domestic and foreign equities affect liquidity on the KOSPI and the currency demand created by overseas investment.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Retail investors are pulling money out of domestic stocks amid volatility and fading AI themes.
